items.text: Hello everyone!

This update marks the start of Season 8 "Myriad Souls", and Season 7 "Rune Secrets" will conclude simultaneously. Additionally, this update expands the Act 4 area \[Crystal Vale], adds a batch of Occult Scrolls and Weapon Inscriptions, and adjusts the performance of 3 weapons. We hope you enjoy the game!
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217060/_/"]

Souls flow in myriad forms. Through mysterious arts from distant realms, one can absorb the essence of great demons and comprehend the power of souls. Inlaying Soul Jades reveals even more wonders. To uncover these mysteries, adventurers have embarked on expeditions. However, many monsters have also been nurtured by these souls and now await the arrival of explorers... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/32e3cde384078b20edbda4813ebcec5c9bb90ce4.png"]

Like previous Seasons, "Myriad Souls" is only available in Nightmare and Reincarnation difficulties. During the adventure, players can obtain various Soul Pendants and Soul Jades, creating different buff effects through strategic combinations. At the same time, players will need to challenge enemies strengthened by demon souls.
Detailed gameplay rules can be previewed in the in-game Season interface.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/43184eedc8a4dd046bb457716610a4b93062072e.gif"]

Complete season tasks, raise your season level, and unlock the "Myriad Souls" avatar frame, season-exclusive spray pack, the "Butterfly Dream" skin for Angelic Aura, the "Abyssal Dragon" skin for Dragon Breath, as well as emoticons, avatars, and other seasonal rewards

items.text: Hello everyone!
The development of the new Season is halfway done. In this issue of Tavern Chat, let's step into another corner of \[Hyperborean Jokul] and enjoy a different scenery...

In \[Hyperborean Jokul], Crown Prince stepped onto the snowy path, moving forward as usual, when suddenly a strange light flashed somewhere. Holding his breath to look closely, he surprisingly discovered a flow of light hidden behind the snow wall by the roadside. Breaking through the wall and venturing deeper, a brand new picture slowly unfolded—twilight snow dancing, the cold wind howling, behind the curtain woven by auroras, mystery and wonder are quietly waiting for explorers to discover...

In terms of enemies, more agile and powerful enemies will join the battle.
To satisfy more combat imagination and enrich build possibilities, we will add a batch of brand new Occult Scrolls.
\[Fortune's Favor]

Occasional deviation from the plan with the Ascension given by Golden Goblet? Don't worry, \[Fortune's Favor] will grant extra Ascension refresh chances, making the Golden Goblet reward more satisfying.
\[Shadow Step]
Teammates running too fast to catch up? When needing to chase the player with the highest Movement Speed, \[Shadow Step] will provide a Movement Speed bonus, ensuring you can fight side by side.
\[Wondrous Chest]
This is a surprise gift with multiple possibilities! \[Wondrous Chest] will offer multiple Occult Scrolls to choose from, allowing you to pick the most desired Occult Scroll according to your needs.
Don't want the Occult Scroll rewarded by the Chest? \ has the ability to refresh Occult Scrolls, providing the surprise of turning waste into treasure.

When encountering text issues such as unclear meaning, stiff translation, or typos, you can submit modification suggestions at any time. We will continue to adopt suitable proposals and thank contributing players in subsequent #Tavern Chat.
Welcome to participate in the localization co-creation of Gunfire Reborn and improve the localization quality of the game with us!

According to the current Development Progression, the Season 8 update will be released in mid-June. We will announce more development information in the next Tavern Chat, including the new Season, Weapon adjustments, etc. Please stay tuned.

This update marks the start of Season 7, "Rune Secrets", and will simultaneously conclude Season 6, "Fortune's Roll". In \[Longling Tomb], while making usual run through the ancient depths, Crown Prince spotted something unusual—a statue glowing with a faint violet light. items.text: Hi folks!
Hard to believe 2025 has entered its final month! As we approach the end of the year, we want to extend our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and companionship.
We hope you've been enjoying the ever-changing battles and strategic depth that Gunfire Reborn offers.

At the same time, we're excited to announce that our final gameplay content update of the year will arrive in mid-December! This update will introduce new Dice, Fortune Cards, Vault, and Jump Stages... Stay tuned for more details!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/0e1ead5e9e52181c9ebccee17874dcc2b06eab0a.gif"]
Mega Summon
Tired of your summons struggling against enemy waves? The new dice effect \[Mega Summon] is here to turn the tide.
With this Dice equipped, summons like \[Iron Wing] and \[Leaf Spirit] get a big boost to their max HP, size, attack power, attack range, and more.
Team up with your newly enhanced, much larger buddies!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/0d5a1856467baea48f360e7c30a02bc2167448dc.gif"]
Polymorph Magic
Ready for some chaotic fun? We're adding a new Dice \[Polymorph Magic].
When you deal skill damage, there's a chance to turn your target into a harmless Dragon Qian.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/f8a171d7dd7eda2b152cccef33aa3b841608f39e.png"]
Extra Slot
Meet the new Fortune Card \[Extra Slot], designed to unlock your full creative potential and enable more diverse builds!
It grants an extra Dice slot with no unlock conditions, though it does come with some side effects.
We're also planning to add more Dice and Fortune Cards to keep your builds fresh, exciting, and full of surprises.
We will add new routes, Vault and Jump stage to Act 3-2 and 3-3 in this mid-season update.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/48829afb57ff803a815ee67121293cce84b74976.jpg"]
-New Vault: Dragon bones wind through the stage as fierce enemy waves attack. Defend the altar to claim your reward!

Natural Shield: We want to fix the big gap in defense performance at different difficulties, especially since it doesn't do well on higher difficulties.

New Dawn: We are preserving the core experience of frequently casting Weapon Skills, but fixing an issue that allowed unlimited capacity of skill resource refunds. This will bring the Ascension's power back to its intended level.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/f5919a6b1a64675a491185e439f956c9e0687527.png"]

So here's some good news — we're expanding its capacity to accommodate your expanding arsenal.

To thank you for your love and support, we're planning to add "Echoes from Primal Grove" and previous Animated avatars and emoticon stickers directly into the game.
You'll be able to unlock them by completing specific in-game conditions with the heroes.
Beyond the mid-season update, we're also working on Season 7, new Weapons, and more. Keep an eye out for future reveals!
Thanks as always for your incredible support. See you next time!

releases.displayName: Tavern Chat #009：Mid-Season Update & New Stages Preview

items.text: Hi folks!
Season 5 "Arcane Talisman" has been live for over a month! How's the new Season treating you?
We're thrilled to see all the creative build ideas shared in the community — combos like Charge Talisman with Stealth or Meteor are so cool :)
Of course, if you've discovered other interesting Talisman builds, please share them in the comments! We'd love to see your ideas!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217060/_/"]
In the upcoming Mid-Season Update, we will introduce the following content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/123faeadf1190046a24e73bb38ae6ae57a375dae.png"]

In the update arriving in a few weeks, all Talismans upgraded to Legendary quality will acquire 3 random affixes. These affixes will expand Talisman build possibilities — such as enhancing Talisman effects, improving trigger efficiency, or additionally triggering Power Gem effects in slots…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/6727ecdeb2ea22a0b938f07287a6be7424577f17.png"]
Unsatisfied with your affixes? You can reforge them at the Talisman Merchant to optimize your build.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/c14e4d3f224f84bf417636d45891242f723db680.png"]
When an adventure ends, you can save current Talisman affixes to the Talisman Vault for use in future runs.
We're adjusting the Ascensions for Xing Zhe's \[Heavenly Arm] faction. After the update, the damage of Xing Zhe's held weapon (excluding Soul Strike) will be improved.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/8abb609bc9597a4516cd24726b1d303e41e5d0aa.gif"]

We're optimizing Bone Dragon's delayed damage activation, while keeping its core ability to continuously pull and cluster enemies. Therefore, the adjusted Bone Dragon will retain its suction effect and trigger multiple explosions during the pulling process, dealing continuous multi-hit damage to enemies.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/31d7f90b51a7cdaff13ac4479e76c5c2058e6a57.gif"]

We've focused our adjustments on Flowing Light's weapon skill and attack range. The number of consecutive attacks from its skill now increases with charge duration—reaching up to 15 hits at full charge. This creates a brief burst phase, making it more effective than before at dealing with groups of enemies directly in front of you.
Planned for autumn, the Season 6 update will expand Act 3 with new branching stages (Act 3-2 and 3-3).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/1bbea023b97bfa1162d23db80bc109872b8749bf.jpg"]
The new Act 3 branches will feature more distinct areas and multi-layered terrain. These stages will offer greater mobility and positioning space for agile players.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/782bf2dda5457ac872a4906dfdde06765c2d7db4.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/f6336ccc6692b66423a2e2b917c4d2e4d10e3c92.gif"]
More oceanic enemies will join the battle, while existing foes like Corrupt Monk, Catfish Man, and Catfish Grunt will change...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/a5d20db0a8c0b1a50866b5dde748854a1e76877a.gif"]
We will also add a unique new mechanism to the stages – you might leverage it to swiftly reach elevated areas or escape pursuing enemies!
We're currently deep in development on the Mid-Season Update, new stages, new Season, and DLC expansions. We'll be rolling out more development insights soon – stay tuned!
See you next time!
---Gunfire Reborn Studio

items.text: Hola folks!

In this update, we have adjusted some gameplay elements of Season 3 'Demon Vanquishment' and added new demon spirit types: 'Elementalist' and 'Minikins'. Additionally, we have introduced the 'Classic Mode' option for the Season Replay System, adjusted some talent effects, and optimized the Logbook. Season 3 has 6 weeks left! Welcome everyone to experience it, have fun!

By the way, this month marks the 3rd anniversary of Gunfire Reborn v1.0 release. Over these three years, we have witnessed the millions of players' reincarnation adventures, and more and more new friends visiting the inn. Thanks for all of your companionship and encouragement, 'Gunfire Reborn' has grown step by step from the Early Access phase to where it is today. In the next year, we will continue to optimize the gaming experience and bring more interesting new content! Please stay tuned!
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio

Long time no see! It's been a while since the DLC release.

Season 3 has been live for over a month now, and we're busily beavering away to get the next phase ready. There's still a bit of a wait for Season 4, so why not take a sneak peek at what's fresh in the mid-season update for Season 3? Let's dive in!
Two new battle companions are coming!
Minikins
Demon Spirits adept at group combat, capable of multiplying the effects of affixes.
Elementalist
Demon Spirits skilled in using elements, enhancing Elemental Effects.
Talent Adjustments

A few talents will have their effects, positions, and upgrade costs adjusted. And some talent descriptions will include animated demonstrations. The cherry on top? A feature to reset all your talents, so you can reallocate your talent points.
Gallery Optimization
A new Skill Gallery will be added, which includes explanations of some basic game rules.
The Occult Scroll Gallery will be able to display the effect descriptions of the Monster Occult Scrolls from 'Bizarre Dream - Interdependent Fortunes'.
Spiritual Puppet
We have made some optimizations to the offensive methods of Spiritual Puppets, and they now have mastered the use of secondary skills!
Classic Mode
The Season Replay System will add a 'Classic Mode' option, so you can turn off the current season's gameplay, and enjoy the original flavor of adventure!
Lyn and Momo's animated stickers and avatars have hit the Points Shop! Get them while they're hot~
The mid-season update still take some time to adjust, and is expected to meet everyone in late November. Thank you for your patience and support.
We will gradually release more details, so please stay tuned.
See y'all soon :)

items.text: What's up, folks!

items.text: News from the Spirit Realm revealed that Ao Bai accidentally discovered another path to the Quicksand Pool during his adventure—an ancient ruins site situated in the desert. With new dangers and opportunities, the time for the group to embark on the adventure is about to arrive.
Entry Requirement: After finishing 'Anxi Desert' 5 times, there is a chance to enter [Beiting Remnant] when entering Act 2 Stage 2 and Stage 3.
[Toxic Spiderling]
Juvenile spider warriors can evolve into spider hunters when fully grown. If disturbed early, they will punish enemies with explosions and venom.
[Bandit Torchbearer]
Facing the insect clan, Rogue Swordsman switched to torches and took on the daily task of driving away those insects.
[Desert Fly]
It has a distant relative of the Desert Worm. The longing for the sky grants it wings. Its ability to attack enemies is somewhat reduced due to the need to stabilize itself in the air.
[Spider Hunter]
The main power of the spider clan. Even in the desert, their webs allow precise hunting and quickly approach and attack with their forelimbs.

As the vanguard warrior of the ant clan, it has comprehensive attack methods, using spears, shields, and firearms. However, due to the backward productivity, it can only use fragile shields to cover vital points.
[Bandit Electrocuter]
The exiled bandits accidentally discovered a way to store electricity. After improvement, they could use the thunder barrel on their backs to emit currents and suppress enemies.
[Desert Titan]
Its enormous stature makes it a special anomaly even among the insect clan. Beneath its slow movements lies immense power, capable of crushing any enemy in its path.

the great talent within spider hunters. Through hundreds of combats, they evolve with tougher shells while retaining agility.

What's up, Folks!

"Seasons" is released in this update, and its First Season - "Arcane Ascensions" is available as well. Additionally, we adjusted and added some Inscription effects, introduced the idle animation of Crown Prince, and weapon skin assembly system. Hope everyone enjoys these contents!

Our initial plan is to rotate seasons every 3-4 months. Each new season will introduce fresh gameplay and rewards. We've also set up some minor challenges for season rewards. Players can unlock them by completing season tasks and levelling up season grades. After the season ends, old gameplay may be closed or partially retained, and progress in old season tasks will be reset (we are considering introducing a season shop in future, where players can use soul essence to unlock rewards from past seasons that they missed). Season task progress and rewards are binded only to the current game save.
If you have more ideas and suggestions regarding season rules, feel free to leave feedback. We will carefully evaluate each opinion and make timely adjustments in subsequent updates.

In the new year, there will be many ideas waiting for us to explore. Besides new heroes and weapons, new gameplay, maps and monsters are also in development. We expect to release the 2024 update roadmap in a few weeks and provide more detail. Please stay tuned.

items.text: Each season features limited-time season gameplay and season tasks. Season gameplay may bid temporary farewell to players after the season ends.
